question: A story where Beatrice gets her hands on a magic device called a mobile game and she can’t put it down, but in the end the battery runs out and she’s teary-eyed.
answer: She gets caught up in “Boyfriend (Provisional)” (note: Japanese online game), but since she tsundere’ed all the choices, she’s facing an ending where she didn’t get close to anyone. “We’ll be friends always, won’t we.” Stop it, stay away, Masahi!! (note: not sure who Masahi is, perhaps one of the game characters.)
